nodes.description: Contract token name string storage (ZEVS FINANCE).
Contract token symbol string storage (ZEVS).
Token decimals (uint8), set to 18 in constructor.
Total token supply (uint256), set in constructor and read by totalSupply().
Mapping of address to token balance; mutated by transfer/transferFrom and constructor.
Nested allowance mapping (owner => spender => amount); mutated by approve and transferFrom.
ZEVS constructor: initializes metadata, mints _totalSupply to msg.sender and emits Transfer.
View returning _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)] using raw subtraction.
View returning balances[tokenOwner].
View returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval; returns true.
Moves tokens from msg.sender to 'to' using safeSub/safeAdd and emits Transfer.
Moves tokens from 'from' to 'to' using safeSub/safeAdd and decrements allowance; emits Transfer.
SafeMath addition helper: c = a + b; require(c >= a).
SafeMath subtraction helper: require(b <= a); c = a - b.
SafeMath multiplication helper: c = a * b; require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
SafeMath division helper: require(b > 0); c = a / b.
msg.sender: caller identity used for minting, allowance keys and balance debits.
approve(): unrestricted write of allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens (allowance race).
transfer(): balance writes balances[msg.sender] = safeSub(...) and balances[to] = safeAdd(...).
transferFrom(): writes balances[from], allowed[from][msg.sender] and balances[to] without checking allowance sufficiency separately.
constructor: mints _totalSupply into balances[msg.sender] and emits Transfer from address(0).
approve() parameter 'spender' used as allowance mapping key.
approve() parameter 'tokens' written into the allowance mapping.
transfer() parameter 'to' used as credit destination and Transfer event recipient.
transfer() parameter 'tokens' amount debited and credited.
transferFrom() parameter 'from' debited and used as allowance owner key.
transferFrom() parameter 'to' credit destination.
transferFrom() parameter 'tokens' amount debited, credited and deducted from allowance.
balanceOf() parameter 'tokenOwner' used as balances mapping key.
allowance() parameter 'tokenOwner' allowance owner key.
allowance() parameter 'spender' allowance spender key.
safeAdd() local return value 'c' = a + b.
safeSub() local return value 'c' = a - b.
safeMul() local return value 'c' = a * b.
safeDiv() local return value 'c' = a / b.
Addition c = a + b in safeAdd, guarded by require(c >= a) overflow check.
Subtraction c = a - b in safeSub, guarded by require(b <= a) underflow check.
Multiplication c = a * b in safeMul, guarded by require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
Division c = a / b in safeDiv, guarded by require(b > 0).

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the minting beneficiary inside the constructor.
Constructor writes the literal token name into state variable name.
Constructor writes the literal token symbol into state variable symbol.
Constructor writes decimals = 18 into state variable decimals.
Constructor assigns the fixed initial supply to _totalSupply.
Constructor executes the privileged minting write operation.
msg.sender is the key under which the minted supply is stored.
_totalSupply is minted into the caller's balance during construction.
Constructor mint writes balances[msg.sender] = _totalSupply.
totalSupply() reads _totalSupply and performs a raw unchecked subtraction.
totalSupply() subtracts balances[address(0)] without SafeMath, risking underflow.
balanceOf() reads the balances mapping for the queried owner.
balanceOf() uses its tokenOwner parameter as the balances lookup key.
allowance() reads the nested allowed mapping.
allowance() uses tokenOwner parameter as the outer mapping key.
allowance() uses spender parameter as the inner mapping key.
approve() executes the allowance write operation.
approve() keys the allowance by the calling account msg.sender.
approve() spender parameter becomes the allowance inner key.
approve() tokens parameter is written as the allowance amount.
The approve write stores the value into allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transfer() drives the balance mutation operation.
transfer() debits the caller account msg.sender.
transfer() 'to' parameter is the credit destination address.
transfer() 'tokens' parameter is the amount moved.
transfer() writes the updated balances into the balances mapping.
transfer() delegates the debit to safeSub to prevent underflow.
transfer() delegates the credit to safeAdd to prevent overflow.
transferFrom() drives the balance and allowance mutation operation.
transferFrom() uses msg.sender as the spender whose allowance is debited.
transferFrom() 'from' parameter is the debited owner and allowance owner key.
transferFrom() 'to' parameter is the credit destination.
transferFrom() 'tokens' parameter is the transferred and allowance-reduced amount.
transferFrom() writes updated balances for 'from' and 'to'.
transferFrom() writes the reduced allowance into allowed[from][msg.sender].
transferFrom() calls safeSub for the balance and allowance debits.
transferFrom() calls safeAdd for the recipient balance credit.
safeAdd() performs the raw addition c = a + b.
Result of the addition is assigned to local c in safeAdd.
safeAdd() returns local c to the caller.
safeSub() performs the raw subtraction c = a - b.
Result of the subtraction is assigned to local c in safeSub.
safeSub() returns local c to the caller.
safeMul() performs the raw multiplication c = a * b.
Result of the multiplication is assigned to local c in safeMul.
safeMul() returns local c to the caller.
safeDiv() performs the division c = a / b guarded by require(b > 0).
Result of the division is assigned to local c in safeDiv.
safeDiv() returns local c to the caller.

normalization_plan.reason: The spender parameter exists only to key the allowance write in approve().
The tokens parameter is consumed solely as the value stored by the approve write.
The 'to' parameter only feeds the recipient balance credit in transfer().
The 'tokens' parameter only feeds the debit/credit amounts in transfer().
The 'from' parameter only supplies the debit and allowance owner keys in transferFrom().
The 'to' parameter only supplies the credit destination in transferFrom().
The 'tokens' parameter only supplies the moved and allowance-reduced amount in transferFrom().
The tokenOwner parameter is only a local lookup key for the read-only balanceOf() function.
The tokenOwner parameter is only an outer mapping key for the read-only allowance() function.
The spender parameter is only an inner mapping key for the read-only allowance() function.
Local c is the transient return slot of the arithmetic helper safeAdd().
Local c is the transient return slot of the arithmetic helper safeSub().
Local c is the transient return slot of the arithmetic helper safeMul().
Local c is the transient return slot of the arithmetic helper safeDiv().
